item.text:
Created `/admin` with a session role check. Users whose session does not have the `admin` role receive Next.js’s `forbidden()` response and a custom [403 error page](/workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx); admins see the [dashboard](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx). I enabled the required auth boundary setting in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts).

The production build passed. With the existing mock session, a request to `/admin` returned **HTTP 403** and displayed the error page. That mock session always has the `user` role, so admin access will depend on connecting `getSession()` to a real session source.
